objectives_fil: Itala ang isang IPC gap, agarang pag-uulat, responsable, petsa at ebidensiya ng follow-up nang walang imbentong resulta.
objectives_en: Record one IPC gap, prompt reporting, an owner, date and follow-up evidence without inventing results.

sections.takeaway_fil: Attendance ay hindi patunay ng supply o practice.
sections.takeaway_en: Attendance does not prove supplies or practice.

sections.takeaway_fil: Gumawa ng improvement card para sa kulang na sabon. Itala ang pansamantalang kaayusan at resulta ng dalawang posibleng follow-up.
sections.takeaway_en: Make an improvement card for missing soap. Record the interim arrangement and two possible follow-up outcomes.

sections.takeaway_fil: Malinaw ang nakita, lugar at oras.
sections.takeaway_en: This identifies what was seen, where and when.

options.fil: Tamad ang lahat kaya tiyak na mali ang kanilang gawain.
options.en: Everyone is lazy, so their practice is certainly wrong.
Station A, nine o’clock: no soap.

options.fil: Lahat ay mahusay dahil may pirma sa attendance sheet.
options.en: Everyone is competent because the attendance sheet is signed.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Bansag ito at hindi tiyak na observation. 2: Malinaw ang nakita, lugar at oras. 3: Hindi sapat ang attendance para malaman ang aktuwal na practice.
check.feedback_en: 1: This is a label rather than a specific observation. 2: This identifies what was seen, where and when. 3: Attendance cannot establish actual practice.

sections.takeaway_fil: Sa follow-up, itala ang ebidensiya, o itala na hindi pa naayos at muling ipaalam.
sections.takeaway_en: At follow-up, record the evidence, or record the gap as unresolved and report it again.

sections.takeaway_fil: Hindi nagsasagawa ang BHW ng clinical audit; iulat agad ang exposure at agarang panganib.
sections.takeaway_en: BHWs do not run clinical audits; report exposures and immediate hazards promptly.

sections.takeaway_fil: Tapat ang tala at may susunod na aksyon.
sections.takeaway_en: The record is accurate and prompts further action.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi pa na-refill ang sabon sa follow-up. Ano ang dapat itala?
check.prompt_en: Soap has not been refilled at follow-up. What should be recorded?

options.fil: Tapos na ang gawain dahil may nangakong magre-refill.
options.en: The task is complete because someone promised a refill.

options.fil: Walang problema dahil may naunang training ang lahat.
options.en: There is no problem because everyone received training.

options.fil: Itala na hindi pa naayos at muling ipaalam.
options.en: Record it as unresolved and report it again.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Pangako ay hindi ebidensiya ng resulta. 2: Hindi pinapalitan ng training ang kailangang supply. 3: Tapat ang tala at may susunod na aksyon.
check.feedback_en: 1: A promise is not evidence of completion. 2: Training does not replace the needed supply. 3: The record is accurate and prompts further action.

sections.takeaway_fil: Punan ang blangkong improvement card para sa fictional na station kasama ang supervisor.
sections.takeaway_en: Complete a blank improvement card for a fictional station with the supervisor.
